name: Guardian formation abilities name the formation they require (#6742-#6748)
contract: Six reports (#6742 Knight's Calling 504151, #6743 Linebreaker 806220, #6744 Brace 800313, #6745 Guard 803895, #6746 Raise Shield 500168, #6748 Battle Rush 501548) all say the same thing: the ability 'can only be used when in X Formation despite not mentioning the requirement in the tooltip'. The requirement is real and is enforced by the core - Spell.dbc column 24 (CasterAuraSpell) names the formation aura, and Spell::CheckCasterAuras refuses the cast without it - but the client renders no tooltip line for CasterAuraSpell, and Stances/StancesNot are 0 on every spell the SQL publishes. rev_20261007_10_guardian_formation_tooltips.sql therefore republishes every learnable formation-gated Guardian ability with the prefix the repository already uses for the Runeshroud runes in rev_20261003_00_coa_palm_sigil_runeshroud_tooltip.sql, '$?a<aura>[|cffffffff][|cffff3232]Requires <Formation>|r' plus a line break, ahead of the client's own untouched description; AscensionCompat streams those rows to the client as SMSG_PATCH_SPELL (opcode 2346) at login. This scenario reads the streamed rows and then proves the text it carries is true. Expected before the SQL: none of the 44 rows arrives and every gated cast fails whatever formation the player is in. Expected after: each reported ability's row carries its formation's line, no row borrows another formation's line, and Brace is refused with no formation up while Knight's Calling succeeds once the Tower Formation aura is on the player.
